extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: two-stage launch rocket with crew capsule and launch escape tower, real size approx. 49 m high, 5.6 m body diameter, 12 m across the fins
extras.notes: stands upright on its four fins; hatch and capsule windows face -Y; engine bells have emissive cyan glow discs; real inset panel seams (ring and longitudinal), rivet rows, cable raceway, classic checkered roll pattern; no text, no flags, no agency logos

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
